content:
In 1995, I built my first website using PERL scripts and HTML for my computer store. Simple quote forms, manual processing, but it worked. I was panning for gold with basic tools that we had at the time.

In this issue

  • Full Disclosure on My Positioning. I'm not affiliated with OroCommerce or any platform vendor.
  • The Gold Mine You're Already Standing On. Aaron shared a scenario that illustrates the buried gold problem: companies with catalogs of 500,000 SKUs watching customers order the same 10 items month after month.
  • The Sales Rep Gold Rush. Another fear I hear about often is "won't e-commerce replace sales reps?"
  • The App Stack Is Fool's Gold. Phase 1: Optimistic Launch. Platform chosen for popularity.
  • How Different Platforms Approach the Gold Mine. BigCommerce B2B Edition: Strong native B2B capabilities in a SaaS model.
  • The B2B Friction Paradox. Aaron articulated something that challenged conventional e-commerce wisdom: friction in B2B isn't a bug, it's a feature.
  • The AI Gold Rush Is Happening Right Now. Roy Rubin, co-founder of Magento, made a bold prediction: we won't even need websites in the future as AI agents handle entire procurement processes directly between systems.
